rows.text: • Increasing full-year adjusted EPS outlook range to $9.25 to $9.75 from $9.00 to $9.50

Taking into account second quarter results, the current margin and macro environment and forward curves, Bunge now expects full-year 2026 adjusted EPS in the range of $9.25 to $9.75, which is up from its previous range of $9.00 to $9.50.
